metadata.title: Launch planning review (docs walkthrough)
metadata.description: Three-speaker planning meeting with timeline-versus-scope disagreement, clear themes, and actionable commitments. Intended for documentation screenshots and walkthroughs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Thanks for joining. Today is the launch planning review for Northwind Notes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Good. I want to settle the date and the feature cut before we leave.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Same here. Support is already getting questions from early access users.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Proposal: ship the public beta on the twelfth of September.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: That date is too aggressive. Shared folders and offline sync are both unfinished.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: We can cut offline sync from the beta and keep shared folders only.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I disagree. Shipping shared folders without offline sync will create a support mess.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: From support, I agree with that risk. Users already assume offline works on trains.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Marketing has already printed the twelfth on the partner brief. Moving it is costly.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Then we should move the date, not ship a half-finished collaboration story.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Could we keep the twelfth for a private beta and announce public on the twenty-sixth?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: That compromise might work if engineering can finish offline sync by the twenty-sixth.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Twenty-sixth is realistic for offline sync if we freeze new features after Friday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: All right. Private beta on the twelfth, public launch on the twenty-sixth.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: I will draft the support playbook for shared folders this week.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I will own the offline sync milestone and report blockers every Monday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: I will update the partner brief and tell marketing the public date moved.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: One more issue: the onboarding tour still mentions the old pricing tiers.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Yes. We must replace that copy before private beta or reviewers will be confused.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I can patch the tour strings tomorrow morning if product sends final wording today.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: I will send final onboarding wording by end of day.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Should we also warn early access users that offline sync arrives with public launch?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Yes. Be explicit. Ambiguous promises are worse than a delayed feature.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Agreed. Put that warning in the private beta email and the in-app banner.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: I will write the banner text and send it for review by Thursday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: We still disagree about analytics dashboards. I do not want them in private beta.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Sales wants a simple usage chart. It does not need to be polished.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Even a simple chart pulls engineers off offline sync. That is the wrong trade-off.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Support does not need analytics yet. Shared folders and sync matter more.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Fine. Analytics stays out of beta. We revisit after the twenty-sixth.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Good. That keeps the risk focused on one collaboration story.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Summary from my notes: private twelfth, public twenty-sixth, no analytics in beta.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Correct. Also final tour copy today, support playbook this week, banner by Thursday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: I will post the offline sync checklist in the engineering channel after this call.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: Thanks. I will close the early access FAQ once the banner text is approved.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Perfect. We have a plan. Let's reconvene next Monday with progress.
